description.value: Alice & Brohm Ice Cream Co. is a New Zealand-inspired real-fruit ice cream shop with two Squamish locations, blending locally sourced BC berries and dairy right in front of customers with no added colours or flavours. Both shops offer outdoor seating — the Mamquam Road location has a large patio at the Squamish Town Hub, while the Second Ave location has a patio just off the downtown main strip. It's a natural post-ride treat stop given Squamish's reputation as an outdoor adventure hub.

The OSM name 'Alice & Brohms' has a trailing 's' not present on the website ('Alice & Brohm Ice Cream Co.'), which is flagged as a discrepancy.
